about_item: [Products include] A total of 360 maple leaves, 6 colors mixed together, 60 pieces of each color.
[Product manufacturing]The artificial maple leaf is made of polyester fabric, which is not easy to deform. The leaves adopts the method of printing first and then cutting, and the lines are clear.
[Product Description] A package of maple leaves in six colors, the size of the maple leaf is 7.5 cm *8.5 cm. Each maple leaf has a clear texture and rich colors, perfect for autumn party decorations.

[Product usage]The fake autumn leaves can be used to decorate your home and various parties, such as Thanksgiving table decorations. It can also decorate your walls, fireplaces, door frames, indoor and outdoor parties or Fall Wedding Flowers. Great for wreath formation, Autumn flower arrangement and a lot of other craft projects! Is the perfect fall theme decoration supplies.

[Product Notice]Each color of the maple leaves is glued together and needs to be separated in advance to dissipate the odor. Only need to rub hard to separate (no need to worry about maple leaf deformation).
